presets.name: Grit
presets.desc: A sampled bite on the high mids of drums and loops, lows and highs untouched
presets.notes: golem's catalogue default, converted faithfully: a 7.6 kHz hold then +7.2 dB on the 1.5 – 2.5 kHz band

presets.name: Megaphone
presets.desc: Lows and highs pulled down, hard clip in the low mids, a heavy curve and a 1.26 kHz peak above
presets.notes: golem's catalogue preset, converted; its Peak now sounds (+9 dB at 1.26 kHz), inert in the headless Prisma

presets.name: Telephone
presets.desc: Outer bands muted into a 300 Hz – 3.3 kHz band-pass, light crunch and crushed bits inside
presets.notes: golem's catalogue preset, converted: Soft clip 16 dB, 7.6 bits, a 14 kHz hold; −60 dB is a mute

presets.name: Broken
presets.desc: Fold on the low mids, crushed and ring-modulated high mids, a sampled top, 80 % wet
presets.notes: golem's catalogue preset, converted: Fold 19.6 dB, 6.1 bits, ring at 159 Hz, a 2.5 kHz hold on the top

presets.name: Bass Split
presets.desc: Fundamental clean below 250 Hz, tube grind on the low mids, hard clip above it rolled off at 4 kHz
presets.notes: The clean-low, dirty-mids bass move with crossovers instead of a parallel blend; LR8 keeps the lows out of the clip

presets.name: Bass Growl Parallel
presets.desc: Bass Split with each driven band blended back with its own clean: growl without losing the pick
presets.notes: The per-band blend has no comb: the dry is aligned with the driven path

presets.name: Chord Clarity
presets.desc: Soft clip on four bands: high-gain rhythm chords that keep their notes apart
presets.notes: Notes in different bands do not intermodulate (Anderton's multiband point); into a clean amp. EXP on focus sweeps body to fizz

presets.name: Tight Low Drive
presets.desc: Clean lows under a hot mid band, a light clipped top rolled off at 6 kHz, for drop-tuned riffs
presets.notes: The 'tight' boost done with bands: nothing below 160 Hz reaches a clipper

presets.name: No-Fizz Lead
presets.desc: Tube and soft clip on the mids, the band above 2.5 kHz left clean and 6 dB down
presets.notes: Dirt without fizz: the top band never meets a shaper

presets.name: Drum Bus Crunch
presets.desc: Parallel crunch on a drum bus: heavy low mids, soft-clipped high mids, crushed top, kick untouched
presets.notes: All three are memoryless, so the 60 % blend has no notch; the low band stays clean

presets.name: Tight Kick
presets.desc: A dead zone on the kick's band only: the hit passes, the tail falls into it
presets.notes: Prisma's own two-module idea folded into two slots: dead zone −27 dBFS, +2.4 dB after; to set by ear on the bench

presets.name: Fold Synth Top
presets.desc: Sine fold on the high mids, triangle fold on the top rolled off at 6 kHz, a clean body
presets.notes: Quality on (4×): folders are the widest-band modules

presets.name: Radio Air
presets.desc: A band-limited, sampled voice: a 5 kHz hold on the high mids, no top, thin lows
presets.notes: Lighter than Telephone: the low mids stay clean

presets.name: Fuzz Upper
presets.desc: Fuzz on the low and high mids only: a solo fuzz whose low band never gates or farts out
presets.notes: Fuzz without mud: the lows below 112 Hz pass clean

presets.name: Edge to Wreck
presets.desc: Light crunch on every band, built for an EXP pedal on Drive: one sweep takes it to a wreck
presets.notes: Drive adds up to +24 dB on each saturator, each along its own law; the make-up keeps the level near
